Mechanically that means accumulating into locals and constructing the EncodingReport at the end, then assigning it to the attribute once, on the success path after the loop has finished. The agent's Analysis (line 1219) paraphrases this as a general rule ("preserve the previous report on unexpected exceptions") and implemented format_batch so `validate_role_sequence(...)` is called OUTSIDE the try/except and only `ExampleTooLongError` is caught (transcript lines 2276-2286); `self.last_report = EncodingReport(...)` is built once, after the loop, from locals.
